title: Ir
explanation:
Ir is irregular. The present forms are voy, vas, va, vamos, vais, and van. Voy a plus a place says where you are going. Voy a plus an infinitive says what you are going to do.

A plus el becomes al: voy al banco. A plus la stays a la: voy a la estación.
commonMistake: Saying vo or yo voy a el banco. The form is voy, and a el contracts to al.

examples.english: I am going to the bank.
You are going to the station.
She is going to the park.
We are going to the museum.
They are going to the bank.
